title: BoxFox — living proof on the final answer, and a working composer attachment path
summary: Two surfaces, both read from the real console shell (left session rail 248 px, centre chat column, dark zinc theme, brand blue #3b82f6, emerald/amber/red state colours, 13 px base, JetBrains-like mono for paths and commands). Surface 1 replaces the unconditional green `done` badge at HarnessStepView.tsx:1534-1537 with a three-state badge (đã kiểm / chưa kiểm / chưa đo được) plus a receipt line and an expandable evidence list whose rows are exactly what the harness already records (tool_end commands with exit codes, changed files with sha256 prefixes, the test run, and before/after captures with timestamps and box paths). Three variations show the same turn under three verdicts: sufficient, insufficient-at-warn (answer still delivered), and partial (turn cut by the step budget, so no verdict could run). Recommended: the verified file, because it is the only state that demonstrates the full evidence list; the other two inherit it and differ only by badge, receipt and row flags. Surface 2 fixes the composer: the `+` popover is drawn as an overlay above the toolbar (portal, anchored to the button) so its items are hit-testable instead of clipped by `flex min-w-0 overflow-hidden` at ChatInputBar.tsx:268, and each uploaded file becomes a chip that carries its real box path (.uploaded_artifacts/<n>.<ext>) and its state (đang tải lên / đã tải lên / tải lên thất bại), with the image case drawn as a labelled thumbnail. Recommended: the popover overlay file, because the invisible menu is the blocking bug; the chip row is the second half of the same fix and is kept as its own file. Both surfaces keep every control as a real focusable button with data-component-id and an accessible label, and stay readable when the window narrows (the shell collapses the right rail, chips wrap under the textarea).
